svg.title: Low-, mid- and high-level features
svg.desc: The image passes through convolutional layers 1, 2 and 3 and more. Layer 1 filters detect low-level patterns such as stripes and curves, layer 2 filters detect mid-level shapes such as corners and circles, and layer 3 filters detect high-level parts such as sleeves. All filters are learned during training. The drawings are a simplification: real filters do not look exactly like that.
svg.text: * sort of — real filters don't look exactly like that
